GSTBot solves the most labor‑intensive part of the Indian GST workflow: reconciling the purchase register with the GSTR‑2B return that the tax department publishes each month. Shopify released its Fall '26 Edition, called Exponential, on October 28, 2026. It lists more than 150 updates across 11 areas, from payments to point of sale — and most of those are merchant housekeeping you can safely ignore.
